name: The Rest of Our Lives
source:
With the arrival of the wealthy Chuck Bing, the city is on fire as the most eligible bachelor has just hit the market. This is good news for Mrs. Bonnet who is looking to get her daughter Liz married off.

During their first meeting however, Liz meets Chuck's friend, Mr. Derby, and the two are immediately at each other's throats. Their fates are interwoven in this sexy tale of romance.

An adult re-imagining of the romantic/drama novel, "Pride and Prejudice" by Jane Austen. It relies more heavily on being an adult fantasy story than a true reenactment of the story.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1169170/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
富有的查克·宾来到城里，这位最抢手的单身汉一出现，便让全城沸腾起来。对一心想把女儿莉兹嫁出去的邦内特太太来说，这可是个好消息。

然而，在初次见面时，莉兹遇到了查克的朋友德比先生，两人立刻针锋相对。在这个性感的爱情故事中，他们的命运交织在一起。

本作是对简·奥斯汀的爱情小说《傲慢与偏见》的成人向改编，比起忠实重现原著，更侧重成人幻想故事。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1169170/]Steam[/url]]
